Habitat V0.4

Changelog

  • Added: Added: New Tool!! Wave! The audio mixer that lets you easily output to multiple devices at once. Have a custom EQ for every app, headphone and speaker!
  • Improved: Menubar icon tools redesigned! Only Chomp and Wave have quick tools at the moment, others to come in the future.
  • Improved: Nook scrub bar, volume controls, and media recognition all added to the nook!
  • Improved: Snap screen recordings now have option to separate audio tracks for mic and system audio.
  • Improved: Keep awake toggle in spark menubar behavior.
  • Fixed: Echo video aspect previews.
  • Fixed: Input delay from switching spaces with a mouse.


    • More to come.

    — Thank you for all the support & feedback!
